Maya (SRE): Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/pm/kvcache-2024. Short: recurring p95 latency spikes on hosted text-gen from KV-cache churn when seq_len > 1024.
Maya (SRE): Proposing temporary SLO window (48h-2w options) to avoid noisy pages while we deploy fixes. Suggest p95 from 120ms -> 160ms for hosted non-dedicated. Also add an error-budget burn alert at 5%/1h.
Sanjay: I can own KV shard sizing and safer eviction. ETA: 10 business days + 72h canary. Will plan A/B with isolated nodes.
Liam: I'll build fallback path (quantized variant) and a gate. ETA: 3w. Need a small infra slot for perf validation.
Rachel (Observability): I'll own dashboard + alert changes. ETA: baseline panels in 2 business days, full alert tuning in 1 week. Need metrics: p50/p95/p99, qps, redwood.kv.cache_hit_ratio, redwood.kv.evict_rate, 1h error-budget burn.
Maya (SRE): Action items: KV shard tuning (Sanjay) - 10d + 3d canary; Fallback + gate (Liam) - 3w; Dashboard + alerts (Rachel) - 2d baseline; Runbook update + recurrence notes (Maya) - 5d; SLA comms draft (Maya + Support) - 3d.
Sanjay: I'll add metrics to the pipeline: redwood.kv.cache_hit_ratio and redwood.kv.evict_rate at 10s granularity. ETA: 48h.
Liam: For trigger, propose smoothed miss-rate over 30s with a min-QPS floor and 15s hysteresis to avoid flip-flop.
Maya (SRE): Agreed. Rachel, make an error-budget panel showing 1h burn and projected daily burn; alert if 1h burn > 5% -> page SRE P1; only SEV if p95 > 250ms.
incident-bot: INC-2024-0423 logged: KV cache churn causing latency spikes. Postmortem link included.
Maya (SRE): Quick sync Friday 10:30 PT, 30m to finalize canary plan. I'll apply the temporary SLO tonight for a 2-week window unless owners object. If ETAs change, update the postmortem board.
